How to scan a page

  1. Capture the page. Use your camera, upload a photo, or drop an image into the scanner. You can also paste an image from your clipboard.
  2. Check the transcription. Choose the page language before scanning, or select a new language and rescan. Use the original image to check spelling, punctuation, and line breaks.
  3. Take the text with you. Edit directly in the text area, then copy the result or download a text file.

Use a sharp, well-lit photo with the page facing the camera.
